title: Offering Circular, Redemption Section — The Redeemable Share Amount of a Class H Preferred Stock Holding, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
A member may redeem the redeemable share amount of a Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding while keeping the holding open.

## Redeemable share amount

The redeemable share amount is the holding's present shares less its unseasoned shares and less the redemption minimum, never below zero, to the cent.

- **Present shares** are the holding's purchases plus its reinvested dividends less its retirements.
- **Unseasoned shares** are the purchases dated within the last 12 whole months and the reinvested dividends dated within the last 6 whole months, counting whole calendar months back from today.
- **Redemption minimum** is the class's smallest balance that may remain after a partial redemption (USD 1000 for Class H Preferred Stock in the capital plan schedule).

## Worked figures (hypothetical holdings)

**Holding A.** Purchases USD 41,000.00, of which USD 5,000.00 is dated 4 months ago and the rest more than 12 months ago; reinvested dividends USD 1,600.00, of which USD 420.00 and USD 410.00 are dated within the last 6 months; retirements USD 2,600.00.

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Present shares | 41,000.00 plus 1,600.00 less 2,600.00 gives 40,000.00 |
| Unseasoned purchases (within 12 whole months) | 5,000.00 |
| Unseasoned reinvested dividends (within 6 whole months) | 830.00 |
| Unseasoned shares | 5,830.00 |
| Redemption minimum | 1,000.00 |
| Redeemable share amount | 40,000.00 less 5,830.00 less 1,000.00 gives USD 33,170.00 |

**Holding B.** Present shares USD 6,000.00, of which USD 5,500.00 were bought 2 months ago. 6,000.00 less 5,500.00 less 1,000.00 is below zero, so the redeemable share amount is USD 0.00.

A purchase dated 14 months ago and a reinvested dividend dated 8 months ago are seasoned and are not part of the unseasoned shares.
